items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen responds to Toto Wolff’s claim that era of "ruthless" F1 drivers is over
detailZh: 四次F1冠军维斯塔潘回应了梅赛德斯车队负责人沃尔夫关于"无情"F1车手时代的结束的说法。
维斯塔潘为自己的方法和频繁的无线电投诉进行了辩护。
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛赛车，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和比赛分析。
四次F1冠军维斯塔潘回应了梅赛德斯车队负责人沃尔夫关于"无情"F1车手时代的结束的说法。
在梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利上周末在墨西哥大奖赛上赢得了他的首个世界冠军后，沃尔夫将这位20岁的年轻人作为一个新类型冠军的例子。
"这种不惜一切代价获胜、自私、机会主义、只为自己利益而冷酷无情的赛车手模式已经死亡，" 沃尔夫说。
"我们现在有一个代表谦逊、正直、忠诚、尊重、真实自我的新冠军。他应该是许多年轻车手在青训车队中的榜样。他也应该是F1中那些有特权的少数人的榜样，那些在无线电中不断抱怨、抱怨、撞车的人。"
沃尔夫没有点名任何车手，但在Interlagos的驾驶员新闻发布会上，维斯塔潘和两届冠军费尔南多·阿隆索被问到了他们的看法。
“我的意思是，每个人都有权表达自己的观点，对吧？我真的没什么别的要说的，”维斯塔潘说。‘每个人都是不同的。我认为这对一级方程式赛车来说是个好事，因为如果每个人都有相同的个性，那就太无聊了。’
阿隆索被邀请分享他对沃尔夫评论的看法，但他拒绝了。
当话题转向维斯塔潘自己的无线电信息时，他谈得更加详细，这些信息经常包含对本赛季汽车的不满。
“关于你听到的我抱怨的任何变化或 whatever，那只是因为我从不满意，因为我认为总有一些事情可以做得更好，我总是尝试微调或找到改进的地方，”这位荷兰人解释道。
“所以如果你听到我在抱怨或者什么的，那更多的是为了确保车队总是在关注细节，试图找到更多的圈速，因为我知道还有更多的圈速可以挖掘。”
维斯塔潘在巴西大奖赛开始前在车手积分榜上排名第二。
detailEn: Max Verstappen responds to Toto Wolff’s claim that era of "ruthless" F1 drivers is over
Max Verstappen defended his own approach and frequent radio complaints
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has responded to Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff's claim that the era of the "ruthless" F1 driver is over.
After Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli clinched his maiden world championship at the Mexican Grand Prix last weekend, Wolff used the 20-year-old as an example of a new kind of champion.
"This notion of win at all costs, selfish, opportunistic, ruthless for your own benefit, that model of racing driver has died," Wolff said.

"We have a new champion that represents values like humility, like integrity, loyalty, respect, being himself. Should be a role model for many other young drivers in junior formulas. And should be a role model for the few entitled ones in Formula 1, the endless moaners on the radio, the ones that complain, the ones that crash."
Wolff did not name any drivers, but Verstappen and two-time champion Fernando Alonso were asked for their views during the drivers' press conference at Interlagos.

"I mean, everyone is entitled to their opinion, right? I have nothing else to say, really," Verstappen said. "Every person is different anyway. I think that’s what is good for Formula 1, because if everyone has the same personality, it’s very boring."
Alonso was invited to share his thoughts on Wolff's comments, but he refused.
Verstappen was more expansive when the subject turned to his own radio messages, which have often featured complaints about the car this season.

"With shifts or whatever that you hear me complain about, it’s just because I’m never satisfied, because I think always certain things can be better, and I always try to fine-tune or find improvements," the Dutchman explained.
"So if you hear it as complaining or whatever, it’s more for me to make sure that the team is always looking into details to try and find more lap time because I know there is more lap time in it."
Verstappen sits second in the drivers' standings heading into the Brazilian Grand Prix.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli admits he questioned himself throughout his rookie campaign
items.summaryEn: Antonelli clinched the F1 title with four rounds to spare in Mexico last weekend, becoming the youngest F1 champion. He admitted that his rookie season made him doubt his abilities, and many had questioned whether Mercedes promoted him to F1 too early.
detailZh: 安东内利坦言，自己在新秀赛季期间一直自我怀疑。
这位新加冕的F1世界冠军表示，他在F1的新秀赛季让他怀疑自己的能力。
安东内利在上周末的墨西哥站成为最年轻的F1世界冠军，当时距离赛季结束还有四轮，他最接近的对手已失去今年挑战他冠军头衔的理论可能。这位意大利车手的强劲表现让他统治了整个赛季——但去年的情况看起来并不相同，当时他18岁进入F1。尽管有几场比赛表现突出，他的新秀赛季大部分时间仍相当艰难。
这让许多人质疑梅赛德斯是否过早将他提拔进F1是个错误决定——而在Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show节目中，安东内利向天空体育前F1车手安东尼·戴维森承认，他自己也曾怀疑过自己。
“其实现在回头看，我非常庆幸车队经历了那些艰难时刻，因为我认为它们塑造了我，”他说。“它们让我成长得快了很多。它们让我成熟得快了很多。而且那一年我也经历了各种各样的情况，你知道的，高潮和低谷。”
“上赛季当然也有美好的时刻，那是一段漫长而艰难的时期。但是，你知道，即便当时非常艰难，我也不打算撒谎，上赛季在那段时期里我一次又一次地怀疑过自己。”
安东内利在梅赛德斯接替了七届世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿，如今他为车队带来了自2020年以来的首个车手总冠军。
“我将永远感激梅赛德斯，感激这个始于2018年的项目中涉及的每一个人。也感激他们去年直接把我放进梅赛德斯赛车，那是一次巨大的冒险。”
直接进入梅赛德斯车队，是的，这很困难，因为我受到的关注要多得多。这促使我努力尝试更快地学习。但话说回来，能够克服那个时刻才是真正塑造我的原因。
当你知道你仍然得到同样的支持，人们的想法甚至没有改变，经历那段困难时期，这也帮助我克服了它，因为我知道，尽管我没有达到应有的水平，或者没有达到期望，我仍然得到了车队的全力支持。
这让我意识到我可以依靠他们所有人，他们总会在我身后，在任何场合帮助我。所以这也帮助我克服了那段时期，也给了我信心。
这位意大利人强调，经历2025年的艰难时期帮助他进步，这最终在今年的比赛中被证明很重要。
“我觉得今年真正帮助我的是，车队接纳了真实的我，”他说。“这让我能在车队里做自己，当然也让我在合适的时机享受乐趣。但这些都极大地帮助了我，让我坐进赛车后能保持专注，尽我所能做到最好。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli admits he questioned himself throughout his rookie campaign
The newly crowned F1 champion says his rookie season in the series made him doubt his abilities

Kimi Antonelli became the youngest F1 champion last weekend in Mexico, as with four rounds to go, his closest rivals lost even a theoretical chance of challenging him for the title this year. The Italian's strong performances allowed him to dominate the season - but the picture looked different last year, when he entered Formula 1 at the age of 18. Despite several standout races, much of his rookie campaign proved difficult.

That led many to question whether Mercedes had made the wrong call by promoting him into F1 too early - and speaking on the Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show to former F1 driver Anthony Davidson, Antonelli admitted he had questioned himself, too.

"I'm actually looking back, I'm very glad that the team went through all those difficult moments because I think they shaped me," he said. "They made me grow a lot faster. They made me mature a lot faster. And also I got to experience all kinds of situations that year, you know, the highs, the lows."

"There were good moments last season, of course, a long difficult period. But, you know, even though it was very tough back then, and I'm not going to lie, I've been questioning myself over and over again last season during that stretch."
Antonelli replaced seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton at Mercedes - and has now brought the team its first drivers' title since 2020.

"I will always be grateful towards Mercedes, towards everyone involved in this project that started back in 2018. And also for them to put me straight into the Mercedes car last year was a big gamble.

"Going straight into Mercedes, yes, it was difficult because I was much more under the spotlight. And that made me push to try and learn even quicker. But then again, being able to overcome that moment was what really shaped me.

"When you know that you still got the same support, that people's mind even hasn't changed, going through that difficult period, that was what helped me to overcome that as well, because I knew that despite not performing at the level I should have or not performing up to the expectations, I still had the full support of the team."

"And that made me realise that I could rely on all of them and that they will always be behind me to help me in every occasion. So that helped me as well to overcome that period and gave me the confidence as well."
The Italian stressed that going through a tough spell in 2025 helped him improve, which ultimately proved important during this year's campaign.

"I think also this year, what really helped me is that the team embraced me for who I am," he said. "And that allowed me to be myself within the team, allowed me to have fun, of course, in the right moments at the right time. But those have helped me massively to then go in the car and be focused and do the best job I can."

2026年F1巴西大奖赛第一节和第二节自由练习的开始时间，以及完整的英特拉格斯赛程、天气预报和直播观看方式
F1本周末移师英特拉格斯，基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛锁定首个冠军头衔后，以世界冠军身份抵达。
这位20岁的车手成为F1史上最年轻的世界冠军，也是自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来意大利的首位世界冠军。梅赛德斯带着对法拉利126分的车队积分领先进入本周末，有望在巴西完成双冠。

哈斯车队将迎来拉斐尔·卡马拉的主场首秀，而科尔顿·赫塔将代表凯迪拉克车队迎来本赛季第六次第一节自由练习出场，他正瞄准获得国际汽联超级驾照所需的最后积分。

What time free practice 1 and free practice 2 start at the 2026 Formula 1 Brazil Grand Prix, plus the full Interlagos schedule, weather forecast and how to watch live
Formula 1 heads to Interlagos this weekend with Kimi Antonelli arriving as world champion after clinching his first title at the Mexico Grand Prix.

The 20-year-old became Formula 1’s youngest-ever world champion and Italy’s first since Alberto Ascari in 1953. Mercedes could now complete the double in Brazil, carrying a 126-point constructors’ championship lead over Ferrari into the weekend.

Max Verstappen arrives in strong form after winning three of the last four grands prix, while Ferrari will look to respond after Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc's first-lap battle cost the team a potential victory in Mexico.

There will also be a home debut for Rafael Camara at Haas, while Colton Herta will make his sixth FP1 appearance of the season for Cadillac as he targets the final point required for his FIA superlicence.
Friday brings free practice 1 followed by free practice 2 later in the afternoon. Here is everything you need to know ahead of Friday’s running at the Brazil GP.
How can I watch the F1 Brazil GP?

How you can watch Formula 1 depends on where you are. For viewers in the United Kingdom, Sky Sports continues as the championship’s exclusive broadcaster, showing every session live throughout the 2026 season. F1 coverage can also be streamed via Sky Go or NOW, with highlights available free-to-air on Channel 4.

In the United States, Apple TV is the primary broadcast partner for the 2026 season, with all sessions available on the platform following a multi-year deal. F1 TV remains the series’ global subscription streaming service.
Motorsport.com will provide live coverage and updates throughout the Brazil GP weekend.

Sunday, November 8 — 2026 Brazil Grand Prix — 2:00pm BRT
Friday is expected to be mostly cloudy and relatively cool at Interlagos, with temperatures around 21-23C for FP1.

Rain overnight and early in the morning could leave some damp areas, but the risk during both practice sessions is currently only around 10%. Temperatures should rise slightly to 22-24C for FP2, with occasional sunshine possible.
Conditions are expected to become much warmer and less settled on Saturday, when showers, thunderstorms and stronger winds could affect qualifying.
Friday sessions: free practice 1 and free practice 2
Saturday sessions: free practice 3 and qualifying

Interlagos is a compact anti-clockwise circuit known for its elevation changes, the downhill Senna S and a technical middle sector before the long uphill run back towards the start-finish line. Its short lap and varied layout traditionally produce close racing and frequent overtaking opportunities.

items.originalTitle: Oscar Piastri accepts Arvid Lindblad clash penalty; guidelines 'tricky' to enforce at Mexico opening corners
items.summaryEn: Oscar Piastri received a 10-second penalty for his Turn 1 collision with Arvid Lindblad at the Mexico City Grand Prix, and while he accepted the decision under Formula 1's driving standards guidelines, he suggested those guidelines may be tricky to enforce at corners like the Mexican opening complex.
detailZh: 皮亚斯特里接受与林德布拉德碰撞处罚；驾驶标准在墨西哥开场弯角“难以执行”
皮亚斯特里因在墨西哥城1号弯至2号弯与林德布拉德碰撞被罚10秒
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，阿尔维德·林德布拉德，小红牛
皮亚斯特里基于F1驾驶标准接受了墨西哥城大奖赛上与林德布拉德碰撞的处罚，但他表示，对于墨西哥开场弯角这类位置，这些标准可能需要调整。
这位澳大利亚车手驾驶迈凯伦赛车在1号弯外线绕过林德布拉德，意图在紧接着的2号弯抢占内线。两位车手都保持了自己的线路，导致林德布拉德的左后轮与皮亚斯特里的右前轮发生接触；这次碰撞将小红牛赛车弹起，撞上出口处的护墙，退出了比赛。
皮亚斯特里因这次接触被罚10秒，这让他失去了第七名的位置。由于随后安全车出动导致车阵收拢，他最终被列为第13名。
他认为，那些需要立即改变方向的弯角使得这些准则难以执行。国际汽联的驾驶标准准则规定，处于内线的车手必须其前轴与前方赛车的后视镜齐平，才能在弯心“获得”赛车空间，但外线移动则要求进攻车手的前轴必须与防守赛车的前轴齐平。
“我觉得看看这些准则，很难对处罚提出异议，”皮亚斯特里开始说道。“但我认为墨西哥的那组弯角，正是准则很难执行的地方。
每个弯角都略有不同，尤其是每一组连续弯道，而且感觉就像当你避免事故的唯一选择是切出赛道时，你并没有处于一个很好的境地。
这确实很困难。我认为阿尔维德非常强硬。我觉得如果你看看指导原则，他有权[防守]，我认为对我自己来说，我也有权尝试让那次超车成立，直到我试图放弃的那一刻，也就是我们相撞的时候。
谈到即将到来的圣保罗大奖赛，皮亚斯特里只是希望在迈凯伦争夺车队积分榜第三名、追赶红牛的过程中能有一个“更干净”的周末。车队在奥斯汀之后落后于红牛，而与米尔顿凯恩斯车队的差距现在已经扩大到17分。
迈凯伦为巴西站带来了修改后的前翼，这应该会为其2027年赛车的研发提供参考，因为车队正努力打造一辆操控更温和的MCL41。皮亚斯特里希望新部件能让当前赛车展现出更平衡的操控特性；两位车手都承认，2026年的迈凯伦需要被“粗暴驾驶”才能达到其理想极限。
皮亚斯特里解释道：“我不认为我需要做出什么惊人的举动；我觉得能有一个更顺利的比赛周末就很好了，这是肯定的。”
“我们这个周末显然为赛车带来了一些新部件，所以希望这能让情况稍微轻松一些，但没必要试图强势反弹并做出什么特别的事情。”
“只是努力在我们一直持续改进的方面继续下功夫，并尽可能让赛车表现得更顺一些，所以这是最大的目标，然后看看我们最终能到什么位置。强行追求不会发生的事情没有意义，所以我们能拿到多少速度就拿多少。”
detailEn: Oscar Piastri accepts Arvid Lindblad clash penalty; guidelines 'tricky' to enforce at Mexico opening corners
Piastri took a 10-second penalty in Mexico City for his Turn 1-2 collision with Arvid Lindblad
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls

Oscar Piastri accepted his Mexico City Grand Prix penalty for colliding with Arvid Lindblad on the basis of the Formula 1 driving standards guidelines - but suggested that those guidelines might need tweaking for corners like the Mexican opening complex.

The Australian hung his McLaren around the outside of Lindblad into Turn 1, with the intent of gaining the inside line for the immediate approach of Turn 2. Both drivers held their lines, which led to Lindblad's rear-left wheel making contact with Piastri's front right; this sprung the Racing Bulls into the air, into the exit wall and out of the race.
Piastri took a 10-second penalty for the contact, which cost him seventh place. He was classified in 13th place, as the field bunched up following the resulting safety car.

He believes that corners with immediate changes of direction make those guidelines difficult to enforce. The FIA's driving standards guidelines state that a driver on the inside must have its front axle level with the mirrors of the car in front to 'earn' racing room at the apex, but an outside line moves mandates that the attacking driver must have their front axle level with that of the defending car.
"I think looking at the guidelines, it's kind of hard to argue against the penalty," Piastri began. "But I think that set of corners in Mexico, that's where the guidelines are very tricky to enforce.

"Every corner's slightly different, every sequence of corners especially, and yeah it kind of feels like when your only option to avoid an incident is to cut the track, you're not left in a great place.

"It's a difficult one for sure. I think Arvid was very robust. I think if you look at the guidelines he had the right to [defend], I think also for myself I had the right to try and make that move stick until the point where I tried to back out which is when we collided."

Speaking about the upcoming Sao Paulo Grand Prix, Piastri simply hoped for a "cleaner" weekend in McLaren's pursuit to reclaim third in the constructors' championship over Red Bull. The team fell behind Red Bull after Austin, and the gap to the Milton Keynes squad has now grown to 17 points.

McLaren has a revised front wing for the Brazilian race, which should feed into the development of its 2027 car as it endeavours to produce a more benign-handling MCL41. Piastri is hoping that the new parts can evoke more balanced handling traits in the current car; both drivers have conceded that the 2026 McLaren needs to be 'manhandled' to reach its ideal limits.
"I don't think I need to do anything spectacular; I think it would just be nice to have a little cleaner weekend, that's for sure," Piastri explained.
"We've obviously got some new bits for the car this weekend, so hopefully that makes life a little bit easier, but there's no need to try and bounce back and do something special.

"It's just trying to work on the things we've continually been working on and trying to make the car behave a little bit nicer if we can, so that's the biggest aim and see where we end up. There's no point trying to force something that's not going to happen, so we'll just take whatever pace we can get."

keyPointsEn: Piastri suggested the driving standards guidelines may need tweaking for corners like the Mexican opening complex.
